thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired: latency-slo-burn (p99) for inference.us-west. Sustained > 12m, current p99 ~560ms, affected routes: /v1/generate (heavy-short-ctx). PD INC-6421. Auto-page sent to oncall.
oncall-alex: Acked PD INC-6421. I'm taking it. Triage starting, ETA 5m to triage and confirm mitigation.
maya: Noted. I'm pulling logs for pool-3 and kv-cache eviction rates. Seeing rising queue depth on batcher-sidecar in us-west-1.
eng-runtime-dev: No recent model or runtime deploy in the last 40m. Telemetry shows batcher CPU spikes and increased scheduling latency for small inputs (0-64 tokens).
oncall-alex: Checking autoscaler + k8s events. Any config flips recently? @sre-jordan any PD noise on your side?
sre-jordan: No config rollouts from infra team. Suggest a quick mitigation: reduce batcher.max_batch_size on pool-3 to reduce queuing and tail amplification.
eng-runtime-dev: Agreed. Preparing a feature-flag flip for pool-3 to reduce max_batch_size from 32 -> 8. This should lower p99 by reducing head-of-line wait.
oncall-alex: Do it and post the command here.
eng-runtime-dev: Running:
```
ffctl rollout set --env=prod --target=pool-3 "batcher.max_batch_size=8" --reason "p99 tail mitigation"
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag rollout started: batcher.max_batch_size -> 8 on pool-3 (rollout id ff-2026-1934). Change applied to 30% of nodes, ramping.
oncall-alex: Seeing immediate effect on queue depth. p95 ~120ms, p99 trending down to 320ms (from 560ms). Continuing to monitor.
product-ops: No customer 5xx spikes in Sentry or support yet. Any visible user impact beyond latency?
maya: No increase in 5xx. This is tail-only. A few internal health checks timed out earlier but recovered after the flag ramp.
incident-bot: PagerDuty reminder scheduled: follow-up ping in 10m if p99 > 400ms.
oncall-alex: Acknowledged. I'll keep PD acknowledged and watch for recurrence. If p99 stays <400ms for 15m we can resolve.
eng-runtime-dev: Note for postmortem: investigate batching heuristics for short-context requests and a potential regression in micro-batching decision path. I'll open INC-6421-followup with traces and flamegraphs.
sre-jordan: Also recommend adding an automated temporary throttle rule for batcher-sidecar when CPU>85% to avoid a full queue buildup.
oncall-alex: Thanks all. I'll update status in 10m and then close the PD if stable. :thumbsup:
summary: PD page for sustained p99 latency in us-west; oncall ack, feature flag reduced batch size to mitigate tail, monitoring for 15m
